title: New advance balance block parses with lenient jint — decimal window/bar values silently truncate at load instead of fail-fast rejecting, bypassing the project's jint_strict integer-only bar
detail: jint returns i32(x) for json.Float, so "milestone_window_ticks": 600.5 loads as 600 and "sla_uptime_pct": 95.9 as 95 — silent truncation at the catalog boundary. Every sibling sim integer (cost, sep tiles, cap_fraction_permille) rejects decimals via jint_strict; the advance block's own comment claims "Fail-fast like its siblings", and its catalog_test rows have no decimal case.
recommended_fix: Parse both advance keys with jint_strict and reject on ok=false (mirroring cost / router_router_sep_tiles); add 'milestone decimal' (600.5) and 'sla pct decimal' (95.9) rows to the advance block's fail-fast table.
